title: PAT I E N T E D U C AT I O N Healthy Bones for Life: Preventing Osteoporosis
abstract:
The following factors can increase your risk of · developing osteoporosis. • Gender — Women are at higher risk of · osteoporosis than men. • Age — The risk of osteoporosis increases · with age. • Body size — People who are quite thin or · have small body frames often have less bone ·
